case.title: Save article from Featured, verify Saved state, find in 'My saved news', and open full article

steps.targetDescription: Target article card in Featured is visible
steps.assertion: Take the next step in your development at UKG

steps.targetDescription: Tap bookmark icon on the target article card (Featured)
steps.locatorHint: section[aria-label='Featured'] [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon']

steps.targetDescription: Saved state indicator on the card is visible
steps.locatorHint: section[aria-label='Featured'] [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon'][data-state='saved']

steps.targetDescription: Open 'My saved news' from profile menu
Saved item with target title appears in list
steps.assertion: Take the next step in your development at UKG

steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-item']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') a[role='link']

steps.assertion: Take the next step in your development at UKG

steps.targetDescription: Navigate back to 'My saved news' list
Unsave the article from Saved News list (cleanup)
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-item']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon'][data-state='saved']

steps.targetDescription: Saved item disappears from list after unsave
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-item']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG')
